codexBlackEd.activeProvider.description: Active LLM provider used for chat. Bridge providers route through the local C++ tray exes in bin/.
codexBlackEd.activeProvider.markdownDescription: Active LLM provider used for chat. Bridge providers route through the local C++ tray exes in `bin/`. Category: **Provider**.

codexBlackEd.activeModel.description: Per-provider model selection map. Keys are provider ids (anthropic, openai, etc.); values are the currently selected model id for that provider. Edited via Settings → Models in the panel.

codexBlackEd.model.description: Anthropic model to use for chat (legacy single-provider setting; superseded by codexBlackEd.activeModel).

codexBlackEd.activeAccount.description: Per-provider active account id. Keys are provider ids; values are the account id selected in the Accounts modal.

codexBlackEd.skin.description: Filename of the active skin CSS from skins/ (e.g. 'noir.css'). Empty string = built-in default.

codexBlackEd.bigFont.description: Render chat at a larger font size for readability. Toggled by the toolbar font button or the /font slash command.

codexBlackEd.fontSize.description: Chat font size in pixels when bigFont is off.

codexBlackEd.language.description: UI language code (matches a file under languages/, e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr').

codexBlackEd.sfxEnabled.description: Enable UI sound effects (button clicks, message-sent chimes, errors).

enumDescriptions: WebSpeech (default — browser-native SpeechSynthesis, no API key needed, no quota; the only keyless TTS option)
ElevenLabs (premium upgrade — high-quality cloud TTS, requires [elevenlabs] api_key in config.ini)
codexBlackEd.ttsProvider.description: Text-to-speech provider. TTS uses keyless WebSpeech by default. ElevenLabs is the premium upgrade. Category: **Voice**.

enumDescriptions: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (DEFAULT — uses [elevenlabs] api_key in config.ini; lowest WER, multilingual, ~150ms streaming latency)
Whisper.cpp realtime (free / offline — runs locally via the whisper.cpp stream binary; one-time ~75MB GitHub release download. Windows only — falls back to ElevenLabs on macOS/Linux)
Faster-Whisper realtime (free / offline — CTranslate2 backend + webrtcvad sliding window; one-time ~150MB Python venv bootstrap with faster-whisper + numpy + webrtcvad. Windows only)
OpenAI gpt-4o-transcribe (uses [api_keys] openai_api_key — batch/streaming via Realtime API)
Deepgram Nova-3 (uses [deepgram] api_key in config.ini — cloud streaming)
Anthropic streaming STT (undocumented Deepgram Nova-3 proxy — uses your Claude Code OAuth login. May break without notice; prefer Deepgram direct)
WebSpeech (last-resort fallback — browser-native SpeechRecognition; only works when the Chromium sandbox allows mic access)
codexBlackEd.sttProvider.description: Speech-to-text provider. DEFAULT is ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (uses [elevenlabs] api_key — same key as TTS). Two realtime local options (whisper.cpp + faster-whisper) replace the deprecated whisper-local batch path as of 2026-05-30. Category: **Voice**.

codexBlackEd.projectFolder.description: Currently selected project folder. Used as cwd for /git, /github, terminal launches, and file-attach pickers.

codexBlackEd.bridgeAutoStart.description: When the active provider is a bridge (claudeBridge / chatgptBridge / grokBridge / geminiBridge / copilotBridge / ollamaBridge), start its tray exe automatically on activation so the first chat doesn't pay a cold-start cost. Category: **Bridges**.

codexBlackEd.bridgeOllamaAutoDiscover.description: On activate, probe localhost:11434 for a running Ollama daemon and populate the model list. Category: **Bridges**.

codexBlackEd.autoUpdate.enabled.description: Auto-pull manifest updates from trentontompkins.com/cbe on activation. Disabled automatically if VS Code's global 'extensions.autoUpdate' is off. Category: **Auto-Update**.

codexBlackEd.autoUpdate.pushOnActivate.description: Admin-only: on activation, push local changes to the trentontompkins.com server via WinSCP. No-op when config.ini is_admin is false. Disabled automatically if VS Code's global 'extensions.autoUpdate' is off. Category: **Auto-Update**.
